Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Ishaan - 11 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Kavita - 40 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Naira - 12 years, daughter
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair
4. Vimla - 67 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses
5. Ananya - 12 years, friend
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair

Places

1. The bathroom - a tap, a bucket, a mirror

Scene 1: The bathroom - Day

[Ishaan stands in the bathroom. Kavita, Naira and Vimla stand near him.]

Kavita: "Ishaan, what's the plan today?"

[Ishaan brushes his teeth at the sink.]

Ishaan: "Really?"

[Ishaan takes a quick bath.]

Kavita (surprised): "I really enjoyed today."
